procedures: All 168 stems, four-choice sets, stored answers, explanations and independent solutions were read and recalculated.
All 672 option truth statements were checked against the stem conditions.
All 28 constructed-response solutions, alternative methods and 0–3 rubrics were read and recalculated.
All 14 lectures were checked for definitions, formula conditions, invalid-use cases, example answers, prerequisite order and non-copying from the bank.
All five SVGs were rendered to images and compared with question text, drawing specifications, coordinates, labels, scales and alt text.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: Correct-option reasons or several rejection reasons were too terse for the verifier.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Replaced each flagged entry with the already independently derived, question-specific calculation or a specific rejection reason; all question hashes and linked review hashes were recalculated.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: Independent-solution text exactly duplicated the stored explanation.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Re-solved and rewrote the independent derivations with different calculation paths.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: Prerequisite descriptions and review notes were overly generic.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Replaced them with skill-specific prerequisite thresholds and concrete review evidence.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: Ambiguity and reviewer-note fields used generic status phrases.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Recorded the unique correct choice, all three rejection reasons, exact unit/rounding/domain checks, question-specific alternate-reading check and complete option truth evidence for every question.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: Question, answer and alt text placed Q at 4, but the SVG circle and label were drawn at the 6 tick.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Moved Q from x=560 to x=480, corrected the drawing specification, rendered the SVG again and added geometry-token assertions.

issuesFoundAndResolved.issue: The drawing specification said M and N labels were below the points while the SVG placed them above.
issuesFoundAndResolved.resolution: Corrected the specification to match the reviewed SVG and added exact label assertions.
